description: Scaffold of the Plaid app emulator: it launches as --port=N, answers GET /admin/health with {"status":"ok"}, and serves the shared admin plane (reset, state, config, quirks). Sandbox public token creation, public token exchange (Item and access token creation), Item reads (item/get), account reads (accounts/get), Item removal and access token rotation (item/remove, item/access_token/invalidate), Item error simulation (the documented error_{CODE} Sandbox passwords and sandbox/item/reset_login), the webhook verification key (webhook_verification_key/get), webhook URL updates with signed delivery (item/webhook/update), institutions (institutions/get, institutions/search, institutions/get_by_id) and Link token creation and reads (link/token/create, link/token/get) are served. A new Item starts with three default accounts taken from the sample response in Plaid's public docs, a provisional fixture to be replaced once the Sandbox default set is captured. The 22 institutions are Plaid's published Sandbox list plus published sample rows, also provisional: products are a template and routing numbers are mostly not published; the remaining Plaid API routes arrive in later slices of build plan plaid-bp1.
